conflicts_and_limits: Signed commits, immutable-storage labels and task dashboards do not certify authorization, recoverability or completion.
Filtered logs must retain required evidence and protect custody.
Automated compliance checks cannot replace authoritative legal applicability or human approvals.
Source maturity and predictive benefits are not actual governance outcomes.
Enterprise role hierarchy and multi-level approvals require appropriate solo/team applicability.
